evidence.field: Description; original file; source; permission; license; file history
evidence.text: The exact File:票-seal.svg page identifies the image as a vector depiction of 票 in Shuowen seal-script style and links its original SVG. It cites S07335 on Hanziyuan as the specific glyph reference, says it was created digitally with Inkscape, and dates the file history to 28 October 2012. The page releases the SVG representation to the public domain; attribution is appreciated but not required. This is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:票-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 說文釋形; 字樣說明; 形體資料表
evidence.text: The entry reports the Shuowen form as 𤐫, glossed 火飛也 (“fire flying”), and says the lower 火 became 示 through clerical transformation. Its listed form sources include Shuowen editions and later dictionaries. This supports explaining the seal-style image as an early dictionary form in the character's history, but does not establish the depicted referent of the upper element.
evidence.title: [A02895] 票 - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

search_audit.query: 票-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons 票 篆书 𤐫 说文 票 字形演变 Xiaoxuetang
search_audit.outcome: Search located the exact Commons file page. Opened and inspected its description, original-file link, source note, license, and file history, and opened the Taiwan MOE character entry to check relevance to the documented Shuowen form. Separately inspected the supplied local SVG file's contents; its embedded vector drawing corresponds to the modern digital artwork described on Commons.

gaps: The proposed file depicts a Shuowen-style seal form, not the older form 𤐫 itself; it should not be captioned as an image of that distinct form.

The Commons page points to Hanziyuan record S07335 as its specific source, but that record was not independently opened in this pass. The image is suitable only as an illustrative modern redraw of the seal-script 票 form, not as a direct artifact record or independent paleographic witness.

items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 票 in Shuowen seal-script style. The Taiwan MOE dictionary reports the Shuowen form as 𤐫, glossed “fire flying,” and says its lower 火 later became 示 in clerical writing; this image illustrates the seal-style form, not an ancient artifact.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style 票 glyph centered on a white square.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the character and script style, links the original image, and records public-domain terms. The MOE dictionary independently supports the relevance of Shuowen's form and the later 火-to-示 change. The redraw can illustrate the seal-style stage while making clear that it does not show the distinct graph 𤐫 or establish the upper element's referent.
